Both get 100% of their November platform fees as credits on their December invoices, no cash: **Loomly $18,400** and **Pinecrest Rentals $6,200** [1][3][6]. That followed a first proposal of 50% (~$9.2k / ~$3.1k) that Rachel upgraded to 100% for both because 1,312 of the 1,840 late payouts were Loomly's and some sellers ate overdraft fees [2].

Yes, it's in the November books: Marcus confirmed on Nov 17 that they're going with a contra-revenue accrual of $24,600 in November, posted by Jenna, reversed when the December credit memos go out [3]. It's also listed as "In progress" on the November close checklist under "Service credits accrual – payout incident (Loomly, Pinecrest)" [10].

One thing not in the November books: Loomly's request to reimburse $7,690 of overdraft fees for 214 sellers stays unaccrued (no decision, answer promised by Nov 25) and is flagged as an open item in the close memo [1][3].
